verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs have a dedicated offline-payments page stating that merchants can keep taking point-of-sale payments during a temporary internet outage once offline payments are enabled. Marketing copy adds that its terminals stay up and running when the internet is down. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the store-and-forward step (how stored transactions are queued and submitted when connectivity returns, plus limits or risk controls), independent or hands-on corroboration.
